problem: Find the equation of the left-opening parabola that has its vertex at $(0,0)$ and passes through the point $(-1,-4).$

feedback.problem: Find the equation of the left-opening parabola that has its vertex at $(0,0)$ and passes through the point $(-12,6).$
feedback.worked_solution:
The general standard equation of a parabola whose vertex is $(0,0)$ and whose arms open right or left is given by

$$
{y}^{2}=4px.
$$

Since we know the given parabola passes through the point $(-12,6),$ we can substitute $x=-12$ and $y=6$ into the standard equation and solve for $p:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{2} & =4px \\ {6}^{2} & =4p(-12) \\ 36 & =-48p \\ p & =-\frac{3}{4}\end{aligned}
$$

So, the equation of the parabola is 

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{2} & =4px \\ {y}^{2} & =4(-\frac{3}{4})x \\ {y}^{2} & =-3x.\end{aligned}
$$
